## Football effect

Jones-Drew carried 22 times for 93 yards and caught three passes before and after the injury was logged, including the 10-yard access run and the 7-yard Power run that set up the winning field goal in overtime. He missed the Monday review on the field and the Wednesday, Thursday and Friday practices; Anderson and Grimes took the backfield work in the chart's order behind him. He cleared September 12 and took the Saturday walkthrough in full; whether he dresses, and with what work, is Stone's decision in the Week 2 record, with no touch quota assigned. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
